visual.caption: 圖 1｜公司員工目錄
visual.description: 連線表示目錄的隸屬關係，三個部門彼此平行；真實目錄還可能包含子部門、電腦、群組和多個網域。

visual.caption: Figure 1 | Company employee directory
visual.description: Lines indicate directory containment; the three departments are peers. Real directories may include subdepartments, computers, groups, and multiple domains.

visual.caption: 圖 2｜一次 LDAP 查詢的四個問題
visual.description: 四個設定共同界定查詢，並列卡片不表示執行先後。

items.title: 01 · Base
items.body: 從哪裡開始查？例如 People 單位。

items.title: 02 · Scope
items.body: 往下查幾層？只查直屬或包含所有子層。

items.title: 03 · Filter
items.body: 找符合什麼條件的人？例如只找使用者帳號。

items.title: 04 · Attributes
items.body: 要讀取哪些欄位？例如姓名、電子郵件。

visual.caption: Figure 2 | Four questions in an LDAP search
visual.description: These settings jointly define the query; peer cards do not imply execution order.

items.title: 01 · Base
items.body: Where to start? For example, People.

items.title: 02 · Scope
items.body: How deep? Immediate children or all descendants.

items.title: 03 · Filter
items.body: Which entries match? For example, users only.

items.title: 04 · Attributes
items.body: Which fields? For example, name and email.

visual.caption: 圖 3｜同一棵目錄的三種搜尋深度
visual.description: 連線只表示父子關係。綠框為 one-level 的候選：Lin、Chen、研發小組；尚未套用 Filter 或權限。base 只查 People；subtree 包含六個項目，不能自動跨到其他網域。

items.title: People
items.body: 查詢起點；base 的唯一候選

items.title: 研發小組
items.body: People 的直接子項目；另有子項目

visual.caption: Figure 3 | Three search depths on the same tree
visual.description: Lines show parent-child relationships. Green outlines mark one-level candidates: Lin, Chen, and the research group, before Filter or permissions. base examines People only; subtree includes all six entries, without automatically covering other domains.

items.title: People
items.body: Search base; the only base-scope candidate

items.title: Research group
items.body: Immediate child of People, with children of its own

visual.caption: 圖 4｜LDAP Search Result：未完整取得結果
visual.description: 教學合成資料。收到兩筆只證明本次可見結果；代碼 4 表示達到筆數限制，不能推論目錄只有兩人。只要求 cn，也不能推論沒有 mail。

visual.caption: Figure 4 | LDAP Search Result: incomplete results
visual.description: Synthetic teaching data. Two entries establish only the visible results received. Code 4 indicates a size limit, not a directory containing only two people. Requesting cn alone cannot establish the absence of mail.

visual.caption: 圖 5｜分批取得結果並確認結束
visual.description: 箭頭表示分頁續查，不代表提升權限或擴大範圍。每頁 100 筆只是示例；檢查結果代碼與最後的空 cookie，總數仍須依實際回傳計算。

items.title: 第 1 頁
items.body: 取得 100 筆，保留伺服器續查 cookie。

items.title: 第 2 頁
items.body: 帶回前頁 cookie，再取一批；示例為 100 筆。

items.title: 後續頁面
items.body: 逐批核對狀態，直到最後收到空 cookie。

visual.caption: Figure 5 | Retrieve batches and confirm completion
visual.description: Arrows indicate paging continuation, without increasing permissions or scope. A page size of 100 is illustrative. Check result codes and the final empty cookie; calculate the total from actual returned entries.

items.title: Page 1
items.body: Retrieve 100 entries and retain the server continuation cookie.

items.title: Page 2
items.body: Send the previous cookie and retrieve another batch; 100 in this example.

items.title: Subsequent pages
items.body: Check each result status until the final empty cookie.

visual.caption: 圖 6｜公司中央員工目錄
visual.description: 連線表示共同使用中央目錄，不表示每次登入必經 LDAP。各系統可查詢目錄；登入與授權也可能使用 Kerberos 等其他協定。

items.title: 公司中央員工目錄
items.body: 記錄帳號、姓名、部門、群組等資訊

visual.caption: Figure 6 | Central company employee directory
visual.description: Lines show shared use of a central directory, rather than a mandatory LDAP path for every sign-in. Systems can query it; sign-in and authorization workflows may also use Kerberos or other protocols.

items.title: Central employee directory
items.body: Accounts, names, departments, groups, and related information

visual.caption: 圖 7｜員工資料：小明
visual.description: 簡化的通用 LDAP Entry（目錄項目）。不同目錄的帳號屬性可能不同，例如 AD 常使用 sAMAccountName；ou 欄位不取代 DN 的位置識別。

visual.caption: Figure 7 | Employee record: Ming
visual.description: A simplified generic LDAP Entry. Account attributes vary between directories; AD commonly uses sAMAccountName. An ou attribute does not replace the DN identifying the entry location.

visual.caption: 圖 8｜一次 LDAP 查詢如何發生
visual.description: 箭頭表示這個查詢的處理順序。回傳內容與查詢狀態要一起判讀，不能把成功回應當成全部資料可見。

items.title: 2 · 送出 LDAP Search
items.body: 指定搜尋位置、範圍與條件。

items.title: 3 · 目錄伺服器
items.body: 根據條件與存取權限查詢資料。

items.title: 4 · 回傳結果
items.body: 小明、小華、小美……以及查詢狀態。

visual.caption: Figure 8 | How an LDAP search happens
visual.description: Arrows show processing order for this search. Interpret entries together with final status; a successful response does not establish universal visibility.

items.title: 2 · Send LDAP Search
items.body: Specify search base, depth, and conditions.

items.title: 3 · Directory server
items.body: Search according to conditions and access permissions.

items.title: 4 · Return results
items.body: Ming, Hua, Mei, and others, together with search status.

visual.caption: 圖 9｜每套系統都要重新輸入密碼嗎？
visual.description: 員工小明上午 9:00 登入公司電腦。三個服務彼此平行；只有適當整合 Kerberos 的系統才能減少重複登入，服務仍各自檢查授權。

items.title: 員工小明
items.body: 上午 9:00 登入公司電腦

visual.caption: Figure 9 | Must every system ask for the password again?
visual.description: Ming signs in to the company computer at 9:00 AM. The three services are peers. Appropriate Kerberos integration can reduce repeated sign-ins, while each service still checks authorization.

items.title: Employee Ming
items.body: Signs in to the company computer at 9:00 AM

visual.caption: 圖 10｜Kerberos 的三階段票證流程
visual.description: 前兩階段箭頭分別表示請求與回覆；第三階段出示票證後由服務檢查授權，「依權限存取」不是固定的 AP 回覆封包。若要求雙向驗證，服務可回傳 AP_REP。AS／TGS 是 KDC 的邏輯功能；省略預先驗證往返、金鑰細節及快取重用。

items.title: 小明的電腦 → KDC / AS
items.body:
階段 1 · AS Exchange
請求初始票證並證明身分
取得 TGT

items.title: 小明的電腦 → KDC / TGS
items.body:
階段 2 · TGS Exchange
使用 TGT 申請檔案伺服器票證
取得 Service Ticket

items.title: 小明的電腦 → 檔案伺服器
items.body:
階段 3 · AP Exchange
出示服務票證與 Authenticator
驗證成功後，依權限存取

visual.caption: Figure 10 | Three stages of Kerberos ticket use
visual.description: The first two stages show request and reply. In stage three the service checks authorization; access according to permissions is not a fixed AP reply packet. Mutual authentication can use AP_REP. AS/TGS are logical KDC functions; pre-authentication round trips, key details, and cache reuse are simplified.

items.title: Ming's computer → KDC / AS
items.body:
Stage 1 · AS Exchange
Request an initial ticket and prove identity
Receive a TGT

items.title: Ming's computer → KDC / TGS
items.body:
Stage 2 · TGS Exchange
Use the TGT to request a file-server ticket
Receive a Service Ticket

items.title: Ming's computer → File server
items.body:
Stage 3 · AP Exchange
Present the service ticket and Authenticator
After validation, access according to permissions
